card.name: Words just before the word cause
card.fires_on: Words right before "cause" or "etiology", such as exact, any, all, and the start of "etiology". It is strongest when the next word is likely "cause".

modes.label: Modifier before cause
modes.description: A word like exact, any or all that sits right before the word cause.
modes.example: Patients with azotemia from<< any>> cause should not be infused with amino acids

modes.label: Start of etiology
modes.description: The opening piece of the word etiology, after "no other".
modes.example: Consider discontinuation of olmesartan medoxomil in cases where no other<< et>>iology is identified.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the word cause or causes next.
card.plain: It fires on a word that is about to be followed by "cause", as in "any cause" or "all-cause mortality".
